name: duopore-public-viewing-schedule-conflicts
description: Find property viewing times that clash, including the gap you want between visits.

interface.longDescription: Find property viewing times that clash, including the gap you want between visits. Enter same-day viewing start and end times, the shared person or resource, and a buffer. See overlaps before you use the schedule. Use simple labels rather than visitor details. The tool does not book viewings, connect to calendars or work out travel time.
defaultPrompt: Check these property viewings for time clashes.
Allow this buffer between viewings and show overlaps.
